title: Closed forms and sharp minima of ω t_c on three classical point-vortex collapse families
description: Project derivations of three closed forms and unique algebraic minima of the scale-invariant product ω₀ t_c on classical point-vortex collapse families. Three-vortex collapse bound (2026-09-19): ω₀ t_c ≥ √2 on Gröbli's Γ = (1, 1, −1/2) family. Parallelogram lock (2026-09-20): ω₀ t_c ≥ 3√5/4 on the Novikov–Sedov four-vortex parallelogram. Quincunx lock (2026-09-20): ω₀ t_c ≥ 3√33/16 on the Novikov–Sedov five-vortex quincunx. The motion is classical. Zero of the five audited candidates is confirmed historically original; the entries are not five independent discoveries. The first formula is a specialization and reparameterization of Gröbli’s 1877 spiral coefficient, as shown in identities/ORIGINALITY-FOLLOWUP.md. Priority of the optimized minima remains unconfirmed. The 2026-09-20 audit in identities/NOVELTY-AUDIT.md supersedes earlier first-discovery assertions. Dates record this project's statements, not established worldwide priority.
